regime_context: The Hong Kong thematic detector shows a narrow leadership: Diversified Miners lead the momentum rank but are ineligible (absolute-trend gate not passed), leaving Tech Hardware & Semis as the highest-ranked eligible theme, with a durable trend (Hurst=trend, durability=0.64) and no crowding. The absolute-trend gate has historically reduced drawdowns in this market, but momentum ranks have near-zero forward IC and are purely an attention lens. All scorable themes (with ETF proxies) are ineligible, so any calls must rest on unscorable baskets with low conviction. Rotation breadth is narrowing (5 of 17 eligible), and the macro backdrop is AI-heavy with very high unscheduled-surprise share, adding uncertainty.
emerging_watch: Watch for High-Dividend Blue Chips to overtake Tech Hardware & Semis as the highest-durability eligible theme (durability >0.68 trend intact) and simultaneously see a relative momentum rank improvement surpassing Conglomerates, which would suggest a yield/defensive rotation taking hold. The condition to retire this watch is High-Dividend Blue Chips failing to improve two consecutive rank positions within 10 days.

theses.thesis: Tech Hardware & Semis is the dominant eligible theme with a robust trend (durability 0.64), not crowded, and benefits from a macro narrative tailwind centered on AI. The absolute-trend gate—the one validated edge in this market—favours it for staying power and reduced drawdown risk, not for return prediction. Overweight is a directional lean for trend continuation within the gate, not a return forecast. Low conviction reflects the unscorable nature of this theme, the tiny track record (n=1), and the extremely high share of unscheduled macro surprises.
